BACKGROUND

A little background

“light” closes Huiwon’s four-track EP 反骨商會, released on May 20, 2025. POCLANOS’s release note describes a band-based record shaped by youthful defiance at eighteen.

  • POCLANOS — EP release notes and track credits (Korean) ↗

INSIDE THE LYRICS

Asking the light to stay

  • Longing
  • Conflicting wishes

The speaker addresses a flash of light as something that could open their eyes and teach them love. A flash is brief, yet they repeatedly ask it not to disappear. That tension makes the appeal feel precarious: they want something fleeting to remain.

The requests change sharply. Being held becomes being broken; having a heartbeat heard becomes having it stopped. Later, cold breath brings forth the image of a white flower, alongside wishes for disappearance and sunset. The final appeals return to being held, letting the flower bloom and receiving a smile. These small gestures of care remain beside the earlier destructive wishes, without resolving them.

ABOUT THE ARTIST / 천희원

Huiwon

Huiwon (천희원) writes and arranges songs built around a band. On 反骨商會, the solo artist also contributes guitar, bass and MIDI programming.

Huiwon wrote the lyrics and music for all four tracks on 反骨商會, released in May 2025. The single Birth… followed in July 2026.
